parent_objective: audit selected-checkpoint outcome localization result and select next repair route
blocked_by: M2244 classifies global dominant failure mode as offtrack_dominated_failure
supersedes: direct reward/curriculum training without outcome audit

public_gates: M2245 must audit M2244 result_class, episode row count, profile-seed support, and guardrails
M2245 must audit global and profile dominant failure modes
M2245 must select a concrete non-ranking repair route
M2245 must not run training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits selected-checkpoint outcome localization and turns failure mode into repair route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2244 episode rows are incomplete
stop if dominant failure mode is inconsistent
stop if repair route would be another checkpoint-selection loop
fallback_plan: route to offtrack/recovery/corridor repair if offtrack dominance holds
route to collision/clearance repair if collision dominance is stronger than summary indicates
route to branch synthesis if localization is inconclusive

training_stage.stage_objective: audit M2244 outcome-localization result and choose repair route
admission_evidence: M2244 global dominant failure mode is offtrack_dominated_failure
allowed_updates: M2245 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2244 completeness and guardrails are audited
failure-mode classification is accepted, refined, or rejected
next repair design route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2245 audits selected-checkpoint outcome localization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2245; no wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Use failure-mode evidence to repair task/reward design; do not lower self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns new episode-level evidence into a repair route instead of repeating diagnostics
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can route current-sim repair toward offtrack/recovery/corridor objectives
must_synthesize_if: M2245 cannot select a repair route
M2245 would propose another diagnostic without repair design
M2245 would rank profiles despite diagnostic-only evidence

hypothesis: M2244 provides enough outcome evidence to route the next repair toward offtrack/recovery/corridor design.
success_criteria: global dominant failure mode is audited
guardrails remain false for training, ranking, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims
a follow-up repair design route is selected
failure_criteria: episode rows or aggregates are incomplete
M2245 starts new training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2245 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2245 makes finite-window-vs-GRU, paper-level, or level3 self-ID claims
